name: Code / API Example
description: API Example product scenario for the Code component.

props.title: request.ts

controls.name: children
controls.description: Source text, shown line by line and copied verbatim; a final line break ends the last line instead of adding an empty one.

controls.name: language
controls.description: Language of the source, set as the `language-*` class of `<code>` for highlighters; Code itself does not color the text.

controls.name: tokenizedLines
controls.description: Syntax colors from a highlighter, one token array per line of `children`; a line whose tokens spell other text renders plain.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Header text such as a file name; without it the copy and collapse buttons sit beside the source.

controls.name: showLineNumbers
controls.description: Number each line in a gutter that is never selected, copied or read aloud.

controls.name: highlightedLines
controls.description: Numbers of the lines to mark, from 1; each renders as a highlighted `<mark>`.

controls.name: collapsed
controls.description: Controlled collapse: a source longer than `collapsedLines` shows only its first lines; a shorter one always shows in full.

controls.name: collapsedLines
controls.description: Lines a collapsed source shows, an integer from 1; a source with no more lines cannot collapse.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names of the copy and collapse buttons and the copy confirmation.
